title: Resolve a System wheel focus from the last drawn owner

scope.subject: Reuse the current System renderer’s real centre projection for unlocked wheel gestures without relying on optional highlight update cadence.

research_summary: Three frozen product browser failures agree: exact #188 R4 attempts 1/2, and independent #189 first, the first real -96 pixel notch on LOW Aurora has unset focus and is explicitly rejected no-planet-focus; next two each contribute one third, camera ends 1.666667 with native/current system active and scale frame ready. Both six-frame centre adapters already compute from camera/body positions; do not copy, prime every frame, choose an arbitrary first target, replay a stale event or use a second camera. Add an identity-bound read from the renderer that actually drew System; call the same projection at input time if no existing locked/explicit target, retain actual empty-space refusal and all endpoint, retention and camera angle oracles. Confirm exact old failure at first wheel with paused real renderer + accepted latest paint. Verify all quality/new-star/context control cases and previous direct and original renderer regressions.

sources.finding: Frozen two attempts of an old test fail before quality eviction or Solar; same three delivered trusted wheels, actual first blocked no-planet-focus
An independent UI-only branch produced the identical first attempt, then passed with different timing; exact attached new-byte controls differentiate product input from hosted slowdown.
Current pinned wrapper projects authoritative body centers using viewport camera and metre scale; periodic highlight sampler throttled to every six draw frames.
R3F frame priorities support a post-render witness without adding a draw. Existing priority-2 presented proof can be reused for native and fallback.

search_ladder.conclusion: Keep whole current native product and fallback System, no new wheel, routing or camera architecture.
The shared canvas renderer/camera and one existing presented frame establish synchronous ownership. Do not introduce duplicate picking renderer.
Reuse renderer centre projection, its body evaluation and same highlight focus bound; bind an actual current scene query for the first unlocked input.
Existing React ref ownership and identity checks prevent standard, fallback, parked and retired providers from influencing the next native/quality owner.

candidates.name: Current native/fallback centre projection via actual presented scene owner
candidates.source: Actual System scenes, React ref registration and R3F presented frame
candidates.reason: Reads already drawn geometry only on first unlocked input. Keeps highlight throttling and blocked empty-space behavior, plus exact physical handoff.

candidates.name: Always scan whole System for highlight every rendered frame
candidates.reason: More hot work when center is genuinely empty, and events can still see cache before after a late camera commit; focus selection must not depend on UI sampling rate.

candidates.name: Choose the first known body or temporarily store rejected wheel input
candidates.source: Current central scale slot and system definitions
candidates.reason: Would navigate arbitrary body or resurrect input after focus ownership changes; preserve explicit locks and fail-closed empty center.

decision.rationale: Directly measures and fixes the first causally rejected input. Existing paint and one timer-free renderer remain sole authority.
decision.fallback: Do not publish if ownership, actual pick, quality/new-star or exact original carry regresses.
